what: A stack of several full-height photo panels is pinned to the screen. Each panel rests 2 beats, then the front panel shrinks to .8 and recedes over 5 beats while the next panel rises straight up from one screen-height below to cover it — the last panel also rests 2 beats and stays 5 beats. On wide screens the receding panel’s text stays as is, below 1024px it fades with it. Pinned for stack height (panel count × 100vh) minus one screen height, with no spacer. scrub 1.1

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Panel (direct child) — screen height, from the second on stacked at top 100vh (fx.css)
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: (if present) text inside the panel — opacity follows the caption when it recedes
options.caption · caption-narrow: Opacity of the receding panel text — default 1 on wide screens (unchanged), default 0 on narrow screens
options.start · end: Pin range, default top top · bottom bottom
options.--fx-count: Panel count (CSS variable) — dummy height = Number of boards × 100vh, the original is 500vh for 6 boards so the consuming side sets the height directly

from.where: index.html .kg-visual__gallery — 6 completed renderings (500vh dummy, panel height 100vh, photo 600:340 up to 80vh). Original timeline defaults duration 5 · previous panel scale .8 ‹+=2” · next page y −innerHeight ”<」 · scrub 1.1 · pin true · pinSpacing false
